svg.aria-label: Work of 94 % of a refresh at 240 Hz: the rule at its threshold
svg.title: Work of 94 % of a refresh at 240 Hz: the rule at its threshold
svg.text: Work of 94 % of a refresh at 240 Hz: the rule at its threshold
The late frames in the pacer's frame window (the last 2 s) over a run. It slows down when they pass the dashed line.
After a change of swap interval the frame window starts empty, so the count falls to zero.
